style.evidence: While the palette has 4-5 value steps per ramp, the shading is applied as rigid, programmatic geometric bands rather than Beodeul-style hand-crafted texture: the left and right metal rails (cols 2-3 and 13-14) are unbroken 1px vertical lines running 37 pixels straight from row 11 to 47 with no structural joints between headboard, side rail, and legs, and the mattress/blanket consists of ruler-straight horizontal stripes (rows 20-21, 28-31, 33-36, 43-45) with no organic cloth folds or surface grain.
